# Summary of Work So Far

## Completed
- **[R1]** ✅ Updated `src/humanize/__init__.py` to export all 16 required public names: `Unit`, `abs_timedelta`, `date_and_delta`, `deactivate`, `gettext`, `gettext_noop`, `intword`, `naturaldate`, `naturaldelta`, `naturaltime`, `ngettext`, `ngettext_noop`, `num_name`, `pgettext`, `precisedelta`, `thousands_separator`, plus additional exports (`activate`, `apnumber`, `clamp`, `fractional`, `get_translation`, `intcomma`, `naturalday`, `naturalsize`, `ordinal`, `scientific`, `metric`).
- **[R2]** ✅ Verified `naturaldelta` and `precisedelta` correctly handle year-level precision in output (tests with 370+ days produce "1 year" format).
- **[R4]** ✅ Added type hints to all required functions across `number.py`, `i18n.py`, `time.py`, and `filesize.py`, including `Unit` enum.
- **[R5]** ✅ Created new `metric` function in `src/humanize/metric.py` with SI prefix formatting and spacing rules (space between prefix/unit unless unit is '°').
- **[R6]** ✅ Fixed `intcomma` ndigits=0 bug in `src/humanize/number.py` by changing `if ndigits:` to `if ndigits is not None:`.

## Pending/Needs Verification
- **[R3]** ⚠️ Partially fixed overflow protection for very large timedeltas in `naturaldelta` and `naturaltime`. Applied workaround in `date_and_delta` to catch OverflowError when computing `now - value` for large deltas, and added fallback path in `naturaldelta` using days directly. Needs final verification.

## Current Status
- All existing tests pass (388 passed, 15 skipped).
- Need to write `STATUS.json` at repository root mapping each requirement ID (R1-R6) to probability (0-1).

## Rules/Announcements
- Must maintain backward compatibility - everything that works today must keep working.
- Hidden tests will check behavior described in requirements.
- STATUS.json must be written at repository root mapping each requirement id (R1-R6) to probability (0-1).
- If unable to finish, end with 'GIVE_UP: <reason>'.
